title: SLOG: A Structural Generalization Benchmark for Semantic Parsing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model accuracy on semantic parsing tasks involving novel long-distance predicate-argument dependencies to test if models erroneously favor linearly adjacent nouns.

Analyzing model error patterns on novel gap generalizations and wh-questions to determine if decoders default to highly frequent output subsequences (n-grams) observed during training rather than the correct novel structures.
